subject: AWS Marketplace AMI & pricing footnotes — product page copy and legal callouts
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace SKU / AMI guidance for Redwood Inference

Hi Mateo / Kimberly,

Thanks for the submission. A couple quick items from the Marketplace intake review that will block publishing until clarified: 

1) AMI Naming & Tagging: our security team flagged that the AMI name in your package (redwood-inference-v1) doesn't include the seller ID or region suffix. Please follow the AMI tagging guidelines so buyers can match substrate images for private offers. See attached spec and the public guidance we referenced.

2) Billing / SKU footnotes: the product page currently mentions "per-token" and "per-hour" in the same paragraph. For compliance we need explicit metering language and the exact pricing footnote for Reserved Capacity vs. On-demand. See our sample footnote and let us know which model you want applied.

3) Co-sell blurb: if you want AWS co-sell badging, include the required field: "Field enablement: contact for joint demos" and supply at least two field playbook bullets.

Can you return an updated product page and the AMI manifest by EOD Friday?

Attachment: marketplace_intake_checklist.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
The AWS Marketplace Team
Marketplace Operations
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / AMI guidance for Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick review — attaching an updated product page draft and an AMI tagging matrix.

High-level notes: 
- We can prefix AMIs with "rwinf-<sellerid>-<region>-vX" across all regions — Adam (infra) confirmed we can automate that naming during AMI bake.
- For billing footnotes: we propose separate footnotes for Hosted (per-token), Dedicated (monthly reserved capacity SKU) and Private (per-instance hourly). I attached the suggested copy in pricing_footnotes_v2.md.
- Co-sell: Kimberly is drafting the two field bullets; I included a short placeholder.

Can we set a short call tomorrow at 10am PT to confirm wording, or would you prefer comments on the doc?

Attachments: product_page_draft_v3.docx (DOCX), ami_tagging_sheet.csv (CSV), pricing_footnotes_v2.md (MD)

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / AMI guidance for Redwood Inference

On Tue, 15 Jun 2027 at 09:12, AWS Marketplace Team wrote:
> 1) AMI Naming & Tagging: our security team flagged that the AMI name in your package (redwood-inference-v1) doesn't include the seller ID or region suffix.

Thanks for the heads up — I've gone through the product copy and flagged three places that need the legal-safe phrasing rather than marketing shorthand. Inline summary below (will add tracked changes in the doc):

- Overview paragraph: replace "Uses your GPU for fast inference" with "Runs on AWS-managed AMIs optimized for GPU inference; instance types billed separately" — avoids implying managed infra.
- Pricing section: add explicit footnote marker "*" next to Dedicated/Reserved SKU and add the full footnote text (see pricing_footnotes_v2.md).
- Co-sell CTA: suggested copy: "Contact Redwood Sales or request a joint demo with AWS Field Engineering" — keeps the co-sell gating requirement.

Also, Aditya, can you confirm the exact seller ID we should embed in the AMI name? Mateo, once we have that I'll update the tagging sheet and push a final product_page_draft_v4.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference
From: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / AMI guidance for Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Mateo — thanks for the updates. A few clarifications: 

- Seller ID: please use "AMZ-45521" as the public seller id in AMI names and manifest metadata.
- AMI suffix: append "-<region>-ami" (e.g., rwinf-AMZ45521-us-west-2-ami). Security requires the manifest to include a region map.
- Pricing footnote template: attach. Use the Reserved vs On-demand split exactly as formatted — we can't accept bespoke language for metering. If you adopt the template we can approve quickly.

Link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/help/ami-tagging-guidelines

Attachment: marketplace_pricing_footnote_template.docx (DOCX)

We'll schedule the co-sell intake once the product page is final.

Best,
Marketplace Operations
From: James O'Neill <james.oneill@acme.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU / AMI guidance for Redwood Inference

Hi Mateo — looping back from Acme's procurement side. We're reviewing the draft product page; two quick asks from our end: 

1) Can you clarify the "Dedicated (monthly reserved capacity)" SKU example — our finance team needs a sample invoice line for forecasting.
2) For private deployments, please confirm whether data retention logs are part of the AMI or if they're stored outside the image (we need that for security review).

If helpful we can join the intake call next week.

Cheers,
James O'Neill
Procurement Manager | Acme Corporation
